Root cause, for triage to close this issue: it is not a flake and not a #31012 regression. The signature (`admin-route-nonadmin-refusal.dogfood.test.ts:618`, plus `admin-platform-admin-standing`'s ADMITTED check) came from PR #31755. It added two `/admin/sso/*` routes without registering them in the two dogfood suites that derive every `/admin/` route (#9482). PR CI runs only the dogfood aggregate, so only the merge queue's sharded run saw it. #31755 registered both routes and merged through the queue with the dogfood shards green. Nothing in the server lane remains open on this signature.
